company.name: Axiamatic
company.shortDescription: Agentic Control Plane for Enterprise Transformation
company.description: Axiamatic is the agentic platform built to accelerate and assure enterprise transformations. Large-scale programs, ERP modernizations, CRM rollouts, post-merger integrations, and source-to-pay migrations, involve hundreds of evolving requirements, decisions spread across dozens of teams, and organizational resistance that rarely surfaces in status reports. Axiamatic continuously ingests signals from 250+ enterprise systems, builds a living knowledge graph of how the program is actually running, and deploys specialized AI agents to detect execution risk, requirements drift, and adoption gaps before they compound into overruns. The platform surfaces role-specific insights and recommended actions for CIOs, CFOs, PMOs, and change leaders, shifting programs from reactive firefighting to proactive assurance. Axiamatic is trusted by Fortune 500 enterprises including Heico, Marmon, Adobe, and Corning, and is backed by Greylock Partners and Bessemer Venture Partners. The company was founded by Rajiv Gupta and Kaushik Narayan, who previously co-founded Skyhigh Networks (acquired by McAfee).

aiResearchSummary.text: Axiamatic is engaged in research and development focused on AI-driven solutions for ERP transformation, as reflected in the work titled 'Message proxying among messaging systems.' This involves receiving messages from users of one system, associating them with threads, translating messages based on user personas, and transmitting the translated content, indicating efforts to enhance communication and integration across enterprise platforms.
